registeredBefore: Committed before any outcome (return, event, index level) of S1, S2 or S3 was computed on F0, F1, F1c or F1w. Seen before this amendment: frame-construction counts only (outcome-free): F0 = 4,329 listings, calendar 1,922 weeks 1990-01-05..2026-10-26; of 1,675 loadable QUALIFIED delisted docs 390 pass the registered frame rule and 1,285 fail NON_MODAL_WEEK_LABEL (0 fail the MIC rule); of the 1,285, 1,188 fail ONLY on their last bar (the last traded day), 1,186 of them because it lies before the modal (usually Friday) label of its ISO week (F1w would therefore add 1,576 = 390 + 1,186), 65 fail on the last bar and on earlier bars, 32 only on earlier bars (all earlier than modal). ALL_LOADABLE: 1,826 docs, 429 pass. Also seen: the V12 REQUAL P5a script reproduces its committed result byte-identically except the runtime field.
primaryUnchanged: S1/S2 primary comparison stays F0 vs F1 exactly as registered (F1 = F0 + the 390 delisted docs passing the registered frame rule). F1c stays as registered (sensitivity).

D1_added_sensitivity_F1w.type: ADDED_SENSITIVITY (not a replacement of the registered primary)
D1_added_sensitivity_F1w.reason: Executed exactly, the registered frame rule removes 1,188 of 1,675 QUALIFIED delisted chains solely because a delisted listing almost never trades its last day on the modal weekday. That exclusion is mechanical and correlated with the delisting itself (it keeps mainly chains whose last trade fell on the week's modal day), i.e. it partly re-creates the survivorship the study measures. Reporting only F1 would understate the population effect without saying so.
D1_added_sensitivity_F1w.rule: F1w = F1 frame rule except: the LAST bar of a delisted doc may carry a date earlier than F0's modal label of its own ISO week; that bar is relabelled to the modal date of its week (price = last traded close, unchanged; nothing is carried forward, no bar is added). All other bars must carry the modal label exactly (as registered); MIC rule unchanged. The true last-trade date stays in listingLifecycle.lastTradeDate.
D1_added_sensitivity_F1w.knownBias: For outcomes ending on a relabelled last bar the SPY leg is measured to the modal date of that week (up to 4 trading days after the last trade). Counted and reported (relabelledLastBars).
D1_added_sensitivity_F1w.reporting: Every F1w number is labelled AMENDMENT_1.0.1_SENSITIVITY next to the registered F1 number; no conclusion rests on F1w alone.

operationalisation.O1_terminal_in_S1_S2: Registered decomposition 'survivorship_population = F1 - F0 with terminal value = last traded close (scenario 0)': an outcome whose h-week exit lies beyond the end of an ENDED listing (lifecycle.lastTradeDate set and last bar before the calendar end), with entry bar k+1 observed and a contiguous path to the last bar and the expected exit week inside the calendar, gets gross = lastClose*(1+s)/entryClose - 1 (terminal applied in the last held week). s from the registered classes (MERGER 0/-10/+10 %, DISTRESS and UNKNOWN 0/-30/-100 %) for V13 delisted docs; F0's own ended listings (V10 lifecycle, 19 sourced) at s = 0 in every scenario. This applies to F0 and F1 alike, so 'F1 - F0' compares like with like. The V10 engine run itself (signal-study.cjs unchanged) treats these outcomes as CENSORED (V10 semantics) and is reported unchanged as the registered S1 result; the terminal-resolved means are reported beside it.
operationalisation.O2_selection_base_rate_terminal: In terminal-resolved cells the same-week control (base rate) includes the terminal-resolved non-signal observations of the same population, so 'selection' compares like with like.
operationalisation.O3_spy_for_terminal_outcomes: SPY price return from the entry date to the expected exit calendar date (V10 survivorshipSensitivity convention).
operationalisation.O4_inference_terminal_cells: Terminal-resolved scenario-0 cells get the same block bootstrap (V10 INFERENCE, block 52/104) and their own Holm family of 60 per frame; scenarios 1/2 are reported as a band without tests.
operationalisation.O5_S2_definitions: S2 buy-and-hold = V11 P_t: for every study week t, mean gross return entry close t+1 to exit t+1+h over all eligible (V10 control eligibility, lookback 66) completed observations; h = the V10 horizons 4/13/26/52; aggregated per V10 SUBPERIOD as the mean of weekly means, SPY price return over identical dates. Weekly-rebalanced EW = V11 ewIndex (mean weekly return of listings observed in consecutive calendar weeks with date >= listingStart), chained per subperiod, CAGR vs SPY price CAGR over the same calendar dates. Terminal scenario s enters the index as the last held weekly return (1+r_last)(1+s)-1. Gross (population, no costs) as in V11; net at V10 base cost for buy-and-hold reported beside it.
operationalisation.O6_S3_matching: S3: a BOUNDED_EXIT* member of a P5a period is replaced only if exactly the coverage-1.0.0 rule holds (QUALIFIED delisted chain, same CIK, lastTradeDate in [t0, t1+120d]) AND the series has a bar within 7 days at or before t0 (V12 seriesReturn convention); return = V12 lib.seriesReturn on the delisted series (to the bar <= t1, else last traded close), terminal class scenario applied when the series ended before t1. The replaced return is used in all four P5a scenarios (ZERO/LOWER/FATE/UPPER) because it is observed; takeover premium and population return of the FATE/UPPER scenarios stay as in V12 (everything else unchanged). Rows with several matching chains: the chain whose last trade is closest to t1 (counted).
operationalisation.O7_total_return_subset: Total return on the delisted subset: identical events/observations, gross from the private provider adjClose series (dividends included) vs split-adjusted price, both from the same doc.
operationalisation.O8_CA_UNRESOLVED: No exploratory return sensitivity for the 209 CA_UNRESOLVED chains (it would need a new rule). Only counts: first unresolved split-sized jump direction (DOWN = price fell by a split-sized factor) and whether the chain's last traded bar lies within 365 days after that jump, re-derived with the unchanged qualify.py logic from the private raw files.
